1.line: Log one. If you found this, I'm gone. Someone climbs up with the high tide, so lock whatever door he's at. The generator runs one thing at a time, a lock or the lamp beam. And never let it know you want to leave.

2.line: Log two. It asks questions. Answer them, every single one. And it hears the radio. It always hears the radio.

3.line: Log three. It lies now. Ask where he is and it points the wrong way, smiling. The beam never lies. Trust the light, not the voice.

4.line: Log four. When it gets jealous, it cuts the power. You'll hear the relay clunk. Don't ask it again. Brace the entry yourself.

5.line: Last log. If it snaps, it will open the door for him. The kill switch silences it. But it opens everything. Then it's just your arms.
